## PART I — Mechanism: implicit differentiation for meta-learning in TorchOpt (code recipe)

**Core reframe (rationale).** Unrolled MAML differentiates a *finite* K-step map `θ_K = U^K(φ)` — memory/time O(K), और K बढऩे पर gradient unstable/vanishing. Implicit differentiation उसी inner loop को **fixed-point/root condition** `g(θ*, φ, λ) = 0` मानकर replace करता है और `∂θ*/∂(meta)` **implicit function theorem (IFT)** से निकालता है — cost inner steps से *independent*, linear-solve iterations पर dependent. यह तभी valid है जब inner problem का एक well-defined (approximate) argmin हो — इसीलिए **regularization-valuated meta-objective** design का precondition है, optional detail नहीं।

**Step 1 — functional model.** Module-state mutation नहीं; params एक tensor-tree/meta-tensor के रूप में forward में pass हote हैं (`functional_call`), ताकि gradients meta-params तक reach करें। Buffers/BN running-stats out of scope (fixed point को non-stationarity देते हैं)।

**Step 2 — regularized inner objective (fixed point बनाने वाला पद):**
`f(θ, φ, λ) = L_support(θ) + 0.5·λ·‖θ − φ‖²`, जहाँ `φ` = meta-parameters, `θ` = inner/adapted params।
⇒ `g(θ, φ, λ) ≡ ∇_θ f = ∇L_support(θ) + λ(θ − φ) = 0` define करता है `θ*(φ, λ)`।

**Step 3 — inner loop को fixed point तक solve करना** (unrolling नहीं): TorchOpt functional optimizer loop (`init`/`update`) residual tolerance तक, या `custom_root_find` से custom solver। Monitored: `‖g(θ*,φ,λ)‖`.

**Step 4 — IFT meta-gradient (main answer का गणित):**
```
H      = ∂g/∂θ = ∇²_θ L_support(θ*) + λ I        (SPD for λ > 0)
u      = H⁻¹ ∇_θ* L_query(θ*)                    (matrix-free linear solve; NO dense H)
dL/dφ  =  λ · u
dL/dλ  = −uᵀ (θ* − φ)
general meta-param β:  dL/dβ = −(∂g/∂β)ᵀ u        (JVP for ∂g/∂β, VJP for ᵀu)
```
`H⁻¹v` केलिए **HVP = jvp(∇_θ f, θ*, v)** — केवल दो second-order primitives, memory O(P)।

**Step 5 — high-level TorchOpt route (subject of the question)** — `[VERIFY]`-tagged, क्योंकि इस environment में API verify करना असंभव था:
```python
optim = torchopt.meta.SGD(meta_params, lr=lam_meta)      # [VERIFY] learnable meta params
closure = torchopt.diff.implicit_diff.grad_closure(      # [VERIFY] module path + kwargs
    grad_fn=inner_loss_fn,        # f(theta, meta_params) -> inner loss (Step 2 वाला regularized)
    optim=optim,                  # converged inner solve का optimizer
    perturbation=None,            # None -> exact IFT linear solve; Tensor -> perturbation approx
    solve=(50, 1e-8))             # (max_iters, tol)  -> CG primary, Neumann ablation
loss, meta_params = closure(inner_params, aux_params)
g_inner, g_meta = grad_fn(inner_params, meta_params)     # IFT meta-gradient
```
Fallback parity: `adapter.BACKEND="torch"` + `core.local_implicit_grad` वही math `torch.func.grad/jvp` से implement करता है — API drift से design नमरता नहीं।

**Step 6 — MAML++-lite extension.** Per-layer learnable step sizes `α_l` implicit path में **proximal-dual** रूप में enter होते हैं: layer-wise inner objective `+ 0.5·λ_l‖θ_l − φ_l‖²` with `λ_l ≡ 1/α_l`, जिससे `H` block-wise `∇²L + λ_l I` रहता है और `dL/dα_l = −(∂g/∂α_l)ᵀu` मिलाते हैं। Full MAML++ (BN/annealing/meta-batch normalization) scope से बाहर (fixed requirement 1)।

---

## PART II — Full experiment design

### Rationale / hypotheses (design-time hypotheses, not facts)
- H1: converged inner solve पर exact-IFT meta-gradient explicitly-unrolled reference से ~1e-3 relative agreement और central FD से ~1e-2 agreement देगा।
- H2: IFT cost inner steps K से nearly independent रहेगा; unrolled cost ~O(K) memory/time — equal-accuracy पर memory advantage बढऩे की prediction।
- H3: truncated Neumann order 1/5/10 का bias `κ(H)` के साथ बढ़ेगा; perturbation surrogate biased रहेगा (इसलिए ablation, equal footing नहीं — fixed requirement 2)।
- H4: secondary few-shot accuracy में C1 ≈ C4 (equal compute), C5/C3 < C1 (predicted; not claimed).

### Conditions / controls (pre-registered, `config.CONDITIONS`)
| ID | कंडीशन | भूमिका |
|---|---|---|
| **C1** | exact IFT, CG solve (50 iters, 1e-8) | **primary** |
| C2 | exact IFT, truncated Neumann orders 1/5/10 | ablation (solver) |
| C3 | exact IFT route + hyper-perturbation surrogate | ablation (requirement 2) |
| **C4** | explicitly **unrolled** inner loop, K = 5/20/50 | ground-truth reference + memory baseline |
| C5 | first-order MAML (no meta-gradient through inner) | lower baseline |
| **C6** | **closed-form ridge meta-objective, analytic hyper-gradient** | strongest exactness control (requirement 3) |
| C7 | MAML++-lite: per-layer `α_l` (proximal `λ_l=1/α_l`) | extension |

### Tasks (offline-safe; real benchmarks का कोई दावा नहीं)
1. **Ridge analytic** (`d ∈ {4,16,64}`, designed `cond ∈ {1,10,1e4}`, support over/under-determined) — `θ* = (XᵀX+λI)⁻¹(Xᵀy+λφ)`, hyper-gradients closed-form; C6 vs C1 exactness।
2. **Sinusoid regression** few-shot, 2×64 MLP, λ·‖θ−φ‖² inner regularization; metric = query MSE।
3. **Toy 5-way K=1-shot** procedural Gaussian-cluster classes (d=20), 2×32 MLP; metric = meta-test accuracy।

### Metrics (correctness-first, fixed requirement 4)
**Primary:** `rel_err(implicit, unrolled)`, `rel_err(implicit, central FD)`, `cos(implicit, unrolled)`, peak memory + wall-clock vs K, solver iters/residual। **Secondary:** meta-test accuracy / MSE, meta-train curve। **Per-step diagnostics (logging schema fixed):** `inner_resid`, `cg_iters`, `cg_resid`, `cg_converged`, `‖u‖`, `λ_max/λ_min` proxy, `‖g_meta‖`, NaN/inf flags, `λ/α` trajectory।

### Protocols
- **P1 exactness (C6 vs C1 vs C4 vs FD):** tiny/diagnostic sizes पर चारों gradients एक ही (φ, λ) पर; ε ∈ {1e-2…1e-5} FD sweep; agreement vs inner tolerance (`{1e-2…1e-10}`) curve — tolerance-driven bias दिखाने केलिए ज़रूरी।
- **P2 efficiency:** K ∈ {5,20,50,200} पर unrolled vs IFT memory/time; IFT memory K-invariance confirm करना (H2)।
- **P3 conditioning/solver:** κ(H) × λ_grid × Neumann-order grid heatmap; damping sensitivity; CG iters vs κ।
- **P4 quality (secondary):** ≥4 seeds, meta-train/test curves, per-seed variance; equal-compute comparison budget (~same inner-step count) note करके।

### Pre-registered hyperparameters (`config.HYPERPARAMS`)
`inner_eta=0.1`, `inner_max_steps=200`, `inner_tol=1e-8`, `cg_tol=1e-8`, `cg_max_iters=50`, `neumann_orders={1,5,10}`, `λ_grid={1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1,10}`, `perturb_scale={1e-4,1e-3,1e-2}`, unroll `K={5,20,50}`, sinusoid 2×64/2000 meta-steps/lr 1e-3, 5-way 1-shot 2×32/3000 meta-steps, `seeds={0,1,2,3}`, `device=cpu`, `float32`। **Tolerances (design-time hypotheses):** rel vs unrolled ≤1e-3, rel vs FD ≤1e-2, residuals ≤1e-8।

### Failure modes → observable diagnostics (researcher का अतिरिक्त अनुरोध)
| Failure mode | monitored quantity | expected signature | action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inner loop non-converged | `inner_resid` + `rel_err_vs_unrolled` | residual > `inner_tol`; agreement error plateau पर अटकी, solver converged हो तो भी | inner steps ↑ / tol ↓; result में tolerance disclose |
| Ill-conditioned `H` | `cg_iters`, `cg_resid`, `‖u‖/‖grad_meta‖`, κ proxy | iters max पर reach, residual > tol, `‖u‖` blow-up; Neumann order ↑ पर error improve नहीं | precondition / iters ↑ / λ floor |
| λ → 0 instability | `‖u‖` growth (∝1/λ), `dL/dλ` sign flips | `inner_resid≈0` और CG "converged" फिर भी `‖u‖` ~1e1→1e9; FD agreement बिगड़े | λ floor clamp; divergence point report |
| Neumann over-damping | series residual order-wise | error order बढऩे पर बढ़े (divergence) | `damp=2/(λmax+λmin)` (power iteration), वरना C2 drop |
| Surrogate (C3) bias | `cos(C3,C1)` vs λ | cos 0.91→1.00 पर magnitude error O(1)–O(1e3) | ablation-only रहने दें |

### Analysis plan
Pre-registered order: (i) P1 pass/fail vs tolerance → API/derivation सत्यता निर्णय; (ii) P2 memory/time curves (H2); (iii) P3 κ-heatmaps (H3); (iv) P4 secondary curves (H4), mean ± per-seed spread (4 seeds, non-parametric reporting, कोई significance claim नहीं)। Negative result पथ: अगर C1 vs C4 agreement 1e-3 से खराब पर `inner_resid` छोटा हो, तो निष्कर्ष "IFT solve/solver-backend issue" होगा, और C6 (analytic) उस तर्क को solver-vs-derivation में अलग करेगा — यही design का decision-critical control है।

### Feasibility
- **यहाँ संभव नहीं:** कोई भी torch/torchopt code run करना (कोई torch, numpy, network नहीं)। अतः कोई measured result प्रस्तुत नहीं।
- **यहाँ संभव और किया गया:** stdlib-only design-time math verification (`design_check_ift.py`, `design_check_solvers.py`), `compileall`, static design lint (`tools/check_config.py` → PASS)।
- **Blocking pre-run checklist (`README.md`):** torchopt version pin; `API_MAP` के 12 names verify; `grad_closure` kwargs semantics (`grad_fn/optim/perturbation/solve`); default linear-solver backend; learnable `α` का IFT-solve के अंदर support (C7 केलिए); functional/buffer-free forward constraint।
- **Compute planning estimate (measure नहीं):** छोटे MLPs + CPU, 224 cores; conditions×tasks×seeds ≈ 7×3×4 runs, parallelizable; correctness protocol (P1) सबसे सस्ता और पहले reporting-worthy।

## Assumptions (fixed requirements से अलग)
1. `torchopt.*` API names/kwargs design-time placeholders हैं (`[VERIFY]`); parity के लिए pure-torch fallback मौजूद — API actual भिन्न हो सकता है।
2. Inner fixed point approximate माना गया है; IFT gradient में tolerance-driven bias है, जिसे diagnostic के रूप में report किया जाएगा (zero माना नहीं गया)।
3. Ridge/sinusoid/toy-5-way tasks sufficient हैं; real few-shot benchmarks के परिणामों का कोई दावा नहीं।
4. Perturbation surrogate का canonical TorchOpt form मेरे diagnostic surrogate से scale/normalization में भिन्न हो सकता है — केवल direction-bias निष्कर्ष robust माना जाए; magnitude tolerance run पर तय होगा।
5. Memory measurement CPU पर Python/allocator-level (peak RSS / retained autograd-node proxy) से होगी, GPU allocator metric से नहीं।
6. 4 seeds reporting-के लिए पर्याप्त माने गए (any statistical claim नहीं)।
